statement.excerpt: In the event this happened, Microsoft’s first move would be to cancel effectively all cloud contracts that OpenAI has, and have to restate guidance to remove the $250 billion in “incremental Azure spend” it promised.

from_speaker: cancel effectively all cloud contracts that OpenAI has
our_interpretation: Absorption means a completed takeover placing OpenAI's business under Microsoft's control, beyond a minority investment or partnership.
The following sentence about Google, Oracle, and Amazon makes external cloud contracts the ordinary reading of the cancellation clause.
Effectively all means all material external cloud commitments, allowing immaterial exceptions.
First move means initial integration decisions; no numerical response window is supplied.
The $250 billion is a purchase commitment described using company terminology, not realized Azure revenue.
criteria.support_condition: After a completed Microsoft absorption of OpenAI, initial integration actions cancel all material external cloud commitments and Microsoft revises guidance to remove the specified incremental Azure commitment.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After absorption, definitive initial integration decisions retain material external cloud commitments, or Microsoft explicitly retains the specified commitment in applicable guidance after addressing the takeover.
